card.fact_statement: The United Thai Nation Party was a member of the coalition government described as "waiting to collapse".
card.source_span: The United Thai Nation Party, another member of the coalition government, has been described by political observers as "waiting to collapse".

target_qa_variants.question: Welche politische Partei in der Koalitionsregierung wurde während der politischen Krise in Thailand 2025 als „wartend auf den Zusammenbruch“ beschrieben?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The United Thai Nation Party, another member of the coalition government, has been described by political observers as "waiting to collapse".
target_qa_variants.translation_note: The English name of the political party is retained, as it is standard practice in German media to use the English or Thai names for Thai political parties. The quote 'waiting to collapse' is translated literally as 'wartend auf den Zusammenbruch'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which political party in the coalition government was described as 'waiting for the collapse' during the political crisis in Thailand in 2025?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The German translation accurately preserves the meaning, entity, and expected answer of the source question.
